title: UNIVERSAL INSTANT ESP SCRIPT!   UNDETECTABLE!
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Color Themes Preset List
local THEMES = {
    ["Navy Blue"] = Color3.fromRGB(0, 102, 204),
    ["Blue"]      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 144, 255),
    ["Red"]       = Color3.fromRGB(235, 55, 55),
    ["Green"]     = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113),
    ["Orange"]    = Color3.fromRGB(243, 156, 18),
    ["Purple"]    = Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 255),
    ["Magenta"]   = Color3.fromRGB(225, 40, 135),
    ["Yellow"]    = Color3.fromRGB(241, 196, 15)
}

-- Current Active Color Theme (Default: Navy Blue)
local CurrentAccent = THEMES["Navy Blue"]

-- Global ESP & Target Settings
local ESP_SETTINGS = {
    Enabled = false,
    Boxes = true,
    Names = true,
    Distance = true,
    Health = true,
    Inventory = true,
    Skeleton = true,
    DroppedItems = true,
    TeamCheck = false,
    TargetUsername = "",
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
    FillColor = THEMES["Navy Blue"],
    TargetColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    ItemColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120),
    OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    -- Orbit Settings
    OrbitEnabled = false,
    OrbitSpeed = 15,
    OrbitDistance = 10,
    -- Teleport & Wall Check Settings
    TeleportEnabled = false,
    WallCheckEnabled = false
}

local ESP_Cache = {}
local Item_Cache = {}
local DynamicUIElements = {
    Strokes = {},
    ActiveTabs = {},
    ToggleIndicators = {},
    TextButtons = {},
    Sliders = {}
}

----------------------------------------------------
-- 1. MOBILE-FRIENDLY GUI CREATION (synQ V1 - SHARP EDGES)
----------------------------------------------------
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "synQ_ESP_Gui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Mobile Toggle Button (Floating Touch Button - KEPT ROUNDED)
local MobileToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
MobileToggleButton.Name = "MobileToggleButton"
MobileToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
MobileToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.4, 0)
MobileToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
MobileToggleButton.Text = "synQ"
MobileToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
MobileToggleButton.TextSize = 14
MobileToggleButton.TextColor3 = CurrentAccent
MobileToggleButton.Active = true
MobileToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local MobileBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MobileBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
MobileBtnCorner.Parent = MobileToggleButton

local MobileBtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MobileBtnStroke.Color = CurrentAccent
MobileBtnStroke.Thickness = 2
MobileBtnStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
MobileBtnStroke.Parent = MobileToggleButton
table.insert(DynamicUIElements.Strokes, MobileBtnStroke)

-- Draggable Mobile Toggle Button
local mDragging, mDragStart, mStartPos
MobileToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        mDragging = true
        mDragStart = input.Position
        mStartPos = MobileToggleButton.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                mDragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if mDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local delta = input.Position - mDragStart
        MobileToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(mStartPos.X.Scale, mStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, mStartPos.Y.Scale, mStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Main Window Frame (Sharp Edges)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.8, 0)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.1, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainConstraint = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
MainConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(420, 560)
MainConstraint.MinSize = Vector2.new(280, 380)
MainConstraint.Parent = MainFrame

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Color = CurrentAccent
MainStroke.Thickness = 1.5
MainStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
MainStroke.Parent = MainFrame
table.insert(DynamicUIElements.Strokes, MainStroke)

-- Header Bar (Sharp Edges)
local Header = Instance.new("Frame")
Header.Name = "Header"
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
Header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 34)
Header.BorderSizePixel = 0
Header.Parent = MainFrame

local HeaderStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
HeaderStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
HeaderStroke.Thickness = 1
HeaderStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
HeaderStroke.Parent = Header

-- Title Label (synQ V1)
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
Title.Text = "synQ V1"
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.TextColor3 = CurrentAccent
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Parent = Header
table.insert(DynamicUIElements.TextButtons, Title)

-- Tab Buttons Container
local TabContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
TabContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 32)
TabContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 92, 0.5, -16)
TabContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TabContainer.Parent = Header

local TabListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
TabListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
TabListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
TabListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
TabListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
TabListLayout.Parent = TabContainer

local function CreateTabButton(text, layoutOrder)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 10
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
    btn.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
    btn.Parent = TabContainer

    return btn
end

local VisualsTabBtn = CreateTabButton("Visuals", 1)
VisualsTabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentAccent
VisualsTabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local SearchTabBtn = CreateTabButton("Search", 2)
local ExtrasTabBtn = CreateTabButton("Extras", 3)
local SettingsTabBtn = CreateTabButton("Settings", 4)

local ActiveTabObj = VisualsTabBtn

----------------------------------------------------
-- 2. SMOOTH DRAGGING & OPEN/CLOSE ANIMATIONS
----------------------------------------------------
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function UpdateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    local targetPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = targetPos}):Play()
end

Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        UpdateDrag(input)
    end
end)

local function ToggleMenu()
    if MainFrame.Visible then
        local tween = TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        })
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            MainFrame.Visible = false
            MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.8, 0)
        end)
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        MainFrame.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.8, 0)
        }):Play()
    end
end

MobileToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleMenu)

----------------------------------------------------
-- 3. TAB PAGES (SCROLLABLE FOR MOBILE - SHARP)
----------------------------------------------------
local function CreatePage(name)
    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    page.Name = name
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -55)
    page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 50)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = CurrentAccent
    page.Visible = false
    page.Parent = MainFrame

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    layout.Parent = page

    return page
end

local VisualsPage = CreatePage("VisualsPage")
VisualsPage.Visible = true
local SearchPage = CreatePage("SearchPage")
local ExtrasPage = CreatePage("ExtrasPage")
local SettingsPage = CreatePage("SettingsPage")

-- Dynamic Theme Refresh
local function SetThemeColor(newColor)
    CurrentAccent = newColor
    ESP_SETTINGS.FillColor = newColor

    for _, stroke in pairs(DynamicUIElements.Strokes) do
        stroke.Color = newColor
    end

    if ActiveTabObj then
        ActiveTabObj.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
    end

    Title.TextColor3 = newColor
    MobileToggleButton.TextColor3 = newColor

    for _, item in pairs(DynamicUIElements.ToggleIndicators) do
        if item.IsActive() then
            item.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
        end
    end

    for _, bar in pairs(DynamicUIElements.Sliders) do
        bar.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
    end
end

local function ResetTabs()
    VisualsPage.Visible = false
    SearchPage.Visible = false
    ExtrasPage.Visible = false
    SettingsPage.Visible = false

    local buttons = {VisualsTabBtn, SearchTabBtn, ExtrasTabBtn, SettingsTabBtn}
    for _, btn in ipairs(buttons) do
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
    end
end

local function SelectTab(btn, page)
    ResetTabs()
    page.Visible = true
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentAccent
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ActiveTabObj = btn
end

VisualsTabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelectTab(VisualsTabBtn, VisualsPage) end)
SearchTabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelectTab(SearchTabBtn, SearchPage) end)
ExtrasTabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelectTab(ExtrasTabBtn, ExtrasPage) end)
SettingsTabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelectTab(SettingsTabBtn, SettingsPage) end)

----------------------------------------------------
-- 4. UI CREATOR CONTROLS (SHARP EDGES)
----------------------------------------------------
local function CreateToggle(text, defaultState, parent, callback)
    local state = defaultState
    
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
    Button.AutoButtonColor = false
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.Text = ""
    Button.Parent = parent

    local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
    BtnStroke.Thickness = 1
    BtnStroke.Parent = Button

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    Label.Text = text
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextSize = 12
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.TextWrapped = true
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Parent = Button

    local IndicatorBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    IndicatorBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 24)
    IndicatorBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -12)
    IndicatorBg.BackgroundColor3 = state and CurrentAccent or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 65)
    IndicatorBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    IndicatorBg.Parent = Button

    local Dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    Dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
    Dot.Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -21, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9)
    Dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Dot.Parent = IndicatorBg

    table.insert(DynamicUIElements.ToggleIndicators, {
        Frame = IndicatorBg,
        IsActive = function() return state end
    })

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        TweenService:Create(IndicatorBg, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = state and CurrentAccent or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 65)
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(Dot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -21, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9)
        }):Play()
        Label.TextColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function CreateSlider(text, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, unit, parent, callback)
    local val = defaultVal

    local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    Frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 54)
    Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
    Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Frame.Parent = parent

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
    Stroke.Thickness = 1
    Stroke.Parent = Frame

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 24)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
    Label.Text = text
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextSize = 12
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Parent = Frame

    local ValLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    ValLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 24)
    ValLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, -10, 0, 4)
    ValLabel.Text = tostring(defaultVal) .. " " .. unit
    ValLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    ValLabel.TextSize = 12
    ValLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ValLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    ValLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ValLabel.Parent = Frame

    local Track = Instance.new("Frame")
    Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 10)
    Track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -18)
    Track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
    Track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Track.Parent = Frame

    local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    Fill.Size = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0)
    Fill.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentAccent
    Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Fill.Parent = Track
    table.insert(DynamicUIElements.Sliders, Fill)

    local isSliding = false

    local function Update(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - Track.AbsolutePosition.X) / Track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        val = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * pos)
        Fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        ValLabel.Text = tostring(val) .. " " .. unit
        callback(val)
    end

    Track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isSliding = true
            Update(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if isSliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            Update(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isSliding = false
        end
    end)
end

local function CreateKeybindSetting(text, defaultKey, parent, callback)
    local isBinding = false
    local currentKey = defaultKey

    local ContainerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    ContainerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    ContainerFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
    ContainerFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ContainerFrame.Parent = parent

    local FrameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    FrameStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
    FrameStroke.Thickness = 1
    FrameStroke.Parent = ContainerFrame

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    Label.Text = text
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextSize = 12
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.TextWrapped = true
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Parent = ContainerFrame

    local BindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    BindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 28)
    BindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0.5, -14)
    BindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    BindBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    BindBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    BindBtn.TextSize = 11
    BindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    BindBtn.Text = "[" .. currentKey.Name .. "]"
    BindBtn.Parent = ContainerFrame

    BindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if isBinding then return end
        isBinding = true
        BindBtn.Text = "[...]"
        BindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)

        local connection
        connection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                currentKey = input.KeyCode
                BindBtn.Text = "[" .. currentKey.Name .. "]"
                BindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
                isBinding = false
                connection:Disconnect()
                callback(currentKey)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- Visuals Tab Controls
CreateToggle("Enable ESP Master Switch", ESP_SETTINGS.Enabled, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.Enabled = val end)
CreateToggle("Chams / Highlight Boxes", ESP_SETTINGS.Boxes, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.Boxes = val end)
CreateToggle("Skeleton ESP", ESP_SETTINGS.Skeleton, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.Skeleton = val end)
CreateToggle("Show Names & Tag", ESP_SETTINGS.Names, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.Names = val end)
CreateToggle("Show Health & Distance", ESP_SETTINGS.Distance, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.Distance = val end)
CreateToggle("Show Inventory Tools", ESP_SETTINGS.Inventory, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.Inventory = val end)
CreateToggle("Team Check", ESP_SETTINGS.TeamCheck, VisualsPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.TeamCheck = val end)

-- Extras Tab Controls
CreateToggle("Show Dropped Items & Gear", ESP_SETTINGS.DroppedItems, ExtrasPage, function(val) ESP_SETTINGS.DroppedItems = val end)

-- 5. SEARCH TAB CONTROLS (ORBIT, TELEPORT, WALL CHECK)

NoticeFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
NoticeFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 28, 20)
NoticeFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
NoticeFrame.Parent = SearchPage

NoticeStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 130, 40)
NoticeStroke.Thickness = 1
NoticeStroke.Parent = NoticeFrame

local ReminderText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
ReminderText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
ReminderText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
ReminderText.Text = "REMINDER: PUT REAL @USERNAME NOT DISPLAY"
ReminderText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

ReminderText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 70)

local SearchBoxFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

SearchBoxStroke.Thickness = 1

local SearchInput = Instance.new("TextBox")

-- Teleport & Wall Check Toggles

    ESP_SETTINGS.TeleportEnabled = val
end)

CreateToggle("Wall Check", ESP_SETTINGS.WallCheckEnabled, SearchPage, function(val)

end)

CreateSlider("Orbit Speed", 0, 100, 15, "studs/s", SearchPage, function(val)
    ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitSpeed = val
end)

CreateSlider("Orbit Distance", 5, 50, 10, "studs", SearchPage, function(val)

end)

----------------------------------------------------
-- 6. SETTINGS TAB (THEME SELECTOR)
----------------------------------------------------
CreateKeybindSetting("Menu Toggle Key", ESP_SETTINGS.ToggleKey, SettingsPage, function(newKey)
    ESP_SETTINGS.ToggleKey = newKey
end)

local ThemePanel = Instance.new("Frame")
ThemePanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 130)
ThemePanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
ThemePanel.BorderSizePixel = 0

local ThemePanelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ThemePanelStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
ThemePanelStroke.Thickness = 1

local ThemeHeaderLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
ThemeHeaderLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
ThemeHeaderLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
ThemeHeaderLabel.Text = "GUI Theme Color Accent"
ThemeHeaderLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ThemeHeaderLabel.TextSize = 12

ThemeHeaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
ThemeHeaderLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ThemeHeaderLabel.Parent = ThemePanel

local function IsVisible(targetPart)
    if not ESP_SETTINGS.WallCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not targetPart or not LocalPlayer.Character then return false end

    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local destination = targetPart.Position
    local direction = destination - origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, targetPart.Parent}
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    return result == nil
end

local orbitAngle = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if ESP_SETTINGS.TargetUsername ~= "" then
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(plr.Name) == ESP_SETTINGS.TargetUsername then
                targetPlayer = plr
                break
            end
        end

        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
            local targetHead = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if targetRoot and targetHead then
                local visible = IsVisible(targetHead)

                -- 1. Orbit Logic
                if ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitEnabled then
                    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if myRoot then
                        orbitAngle = orbitAngle + (ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitSpeed * deltaTime)
                        local offsetX = math.cos(orbitAngle) * ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitDistance
                        local offsetZ = math.sin(orbitAngle) * ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitDistance
                        local newPos = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ)
                        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetRoot.Position)
                    end
                end

                -- 2. Teleport Logic
                if ESP_SETTINGS.TeleportEnabled and visible then
                    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if myRoot then
                        myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local LineFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
LineFolder.Name = "synQ_SkeletonLines"
LineFolder.Parent = ScreenGui

local function CreateLine()
    local line = Instance.new("Frame")
    line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    line.BorderSizePixel = 0
    line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    line.Visible = false
    line.Parent = LineFolder
    return line
end

local function ConnectJoints(p1, p2, line, color)
    if not (p1 and p2) then line.Visible = false return end
    local pos1, vis1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p1.Position)
    local pos2, vis2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p2.Position)

    if vis1 and vis2 then
        local startVec = Vector2.new(pos1.X, pos1.Y)
        local endVec = Vector2.new(pos2.X, pos2.Y)
        local distance = (startVec - endVec).Magnitude
        local center = (startVec + endVec) / 2
        local angle = math.atan2(endVec.Y - startVec.Y, endVec.X - startVec.X)

        line.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)
        line.Position = UDim2.new(0, center.X, 0, center.Y)
        line.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
        line.BackgroundColor3 = color
        line.Visible = true
    else
        line.Visible = false
    end
end

local function GetPlayerInventory(plr)
    local items = {}
    if plr.Character then
        for _, obj in pairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(items, "[E] " .. obj.Name) end
        end
    end
    local backpack = plr:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if backpack then
        for _, obj in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(items, obj.Name) end
        end
    end
    return #items == 0 and "Empty" or table.concat(items, ", ")
end

local function TrackWorkspaceItem(item)
    if item:IsA("Tool") and not item:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
        local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle") or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if handle and not Item_Cache[item] then
            local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            billboard.Name = "synQ_ItemBillboard"
            billboard.Adornee = handle
            billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
            billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
            billboard.Enabled = false
            billboard.Parent = item

            local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            label.TextSize = 12
            label.TextColor3 = ESP_SETTINGS.ItemColor
            label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
            label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            label.Parent = billboard

            Item_Cache[item] = {
                Billboard = billboard,
                Label = label,
                Part = handle
            }
        end
    end
end

for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do TrackWorkspaceItem(obj) end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(TrackWorkspaceItem)
workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(obj)
    if Item_Cache[obj] then
        if Item_Cache[obj].Billboard then Item_Cache[obj].Billboard:Destroy() end
        Item_Cache[obj] = nil
    end
end)

local function AddESP(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function Apply(char)
        if not char then return end
        
        if ESP_Cache[plr] then
            for _, v in pairs(ESP_Cache[plr].Lines or {}) do v:Destroy() end
            if ESP_Cache[plr].Highlight then ESP_Cache[plr].Highlight:Destroy() end
            if ESP_Cache[plr].Billboard then ESP_Cache[plr].Billboard:Destroy() end
        end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.Name = "synQ_Highlight"
        highlight.Adornee = char
        highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = char

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = "synQ_Billboard"
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 80)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = char

        local tagLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tagLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tagLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tagLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tagLabel.TextSize = 12
        tagLabel.TextColor3 = ESP_SETTINGS.TextColor
        tagLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
        tagLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        tagLabel.Parent = billboard

        local lines = {}
        for i = 1, 12 do table.insert(lines, CreateLine()) end

        ESP_Cache[plr] = {
            Highlight = highlight,
            Billboard = billboard,
            Label = tagLabel,
            Lines = lines,
            Character = char
        }
    end

    if plr.Character then Apply(plr.Character) end
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(Apply)
end

for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do AddESP(plr) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(AddESP)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    if ESP_Cache[plr] then
        for _, v in pairs(ESP_Cache[plr].Lines or {}) do v:Destroy() end
        if ESP_Cache[plr].Highlight then ESP_Cache[plr].Highlight:Destroy() end
        if ESP_Cache[plr].Billboard then ESP_Cache[plr].Billboard:Destroy() end
        ESP_Cache[plr] = nil
    end
end)

    for plr, data in pairs(ESP_Cache) do
        local char = data.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

        if char and char.Parent and root and head and hum and hum.Health > 0 then

            local activeColor = isTarget and ESP_SETTINGS.TargetColor or ESP_SETTINGS.FillColor

            if ESP_SETTINGS.Enabled and isEnemy then
                data.Highlight.FillColor = activeColor
                data.Highlight.OutlineColor = isTarget and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or ESP_SETTINGS.OutlineColor
                data.Highlight.Enabled = ESP_SETTINGS.Boxes

                data.Billboard.Adornee = head
                local dist = math.floor((root.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude)
                local hp = math.floor(hum.Health)

                local textFormat = ""
                if isTarget then textFormat = textFormat .. "[TARGET] " end
                if ESP_SETTINGS.Names then textFormat = textFormat .. plr.DisplayName .. " (@" .. plr.Name .. ")\n" end
                if ESP_SETTINGS.Distance then textFormat = textFormat .. "[" .. hp .. " HP] • " .. dist .. "m\n" end
                if ESP_SETTINGS.Inventory then textFormat = textFormat .. "Holding: " .. GetPlayerInventory(plr) end

                data.Label.Text = textFormat
                data.Label.TextColor3 = isTarget and Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90) or ESP_SETTINGS.TextColor
                data.Billboard.Enabled = ESP_SETTINGS.Names or ESP_SETTINGS.Distance or ESP_SETTINGS.Inventory

                if ESP_SETTINGS.Skeleton then
                    local R6 = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") ~= nil
                    if R6 then
                        ConnectJoints(head, char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), data.Lines[1], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm"), data.Lines[2], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"), data.Lines[3], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg"), data.Lines[4], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg"), data.Lines[5], activeColor)
                        for i = 6, 12 do data.Lines[i].Visible = false end
                    else
                        ConnectJoints(head, char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), data.Lines[1], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), data.Lines[2], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), data.Lines[3], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm"), data.Lines[4], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), data.Lines[5], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm"), data.Lines[6], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), data.Lines[7], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg"), data.Lines[8], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), data.Lines[9], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg"), data.Lines[10], activeColor)
                        for i = 11, 12 do data.Lines[i].Visible = false end
                    end
                else
                    for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
                end
            else
                data.Highlight.Enabled = false
                data.Billboard.Enabled = false
                for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
            end
        else
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
            for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
        end
    end

    for item, data in pairs(Item_Cache) do
        if item and item.Parent and data.Part and ESP_SETTINGS.Enabled and ESP_SETTINGS.DroppedItems then
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local dist = math.floor((data.Part.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude)
                data.Label.Text = "📦 " .. item.Name .. " [" .. dist .. "m]"
                data.Billboard.Enabled = true
            else
                data.Billboard.Enabled = false
            end
        else
            if data.Billboard then data.Billboard.Enabled = false end
        end
    end
end)
